structure.unit: Taxes Administered by the Department of Taxation
Payment of Death Taxes Due by Nonresident Decedents to Other States

law.catch_line: Final accounting not granted without compliance
law.text: Unless the provisions of either § 58.1-914 or § 58.1-915 have been complied with, no such executor or administrator shall be entitled to a final accounting or discharge in any court in this Commonwealth.
